notes: Scoped Effect registration with idempotent removal, exact same-page grants, serial nonrecursive callbacks and one action/assertion deadline. Removal is by registration, not locator identity. Callback typed errors retain their value in process; timeouts use normal enclosing-operation attribution.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: explicit removal prevents new selections, while scope release interrupts selected work.
